newsitem.title: FRANCE: GTM Entrepose sees lower 1996 result.
newsitem.headline: GTM Entrepose sees lower 1996 result.

text.p: French construction group GTM Entrepose said on Tuesday it expected lower results for the full year 1996 if business in the roads and buildings sectors did not improve. Turnover was expected to be similar to 1995.
GTM Entrepose is 48 percent owned by water company Lyonnaise des Eaux, which posts first-half results on Thursday.

"The results for the year should see a retreat...if the weakness in the road sector continues to the end of the year and if the building sector, as well as the outlook for 1997, make it necessary to take further adaptive measures," the company said in a newspaper advertisement.
Full-year consolidated turnover should be of the same order of magnitude as that of 1995 on a like-for-like basis, it said.
GTM Entrepose earlier posted a first-half net attributable loss of 23 million francs versus a loss of 18 million a year ago.

It had 1995 net attributable profit of 198 million francs on turnover of 38.05 billion. The group last year took over 100 percent of Dumez-GTM, which was previously 50 percent-owned, and 96 percent of Jean Lefebvre, of which it previously held 52 percent.
